criteria.name: COMPLETENESS
criteria.rule: Required migration planning, authority, contract-input, gate and test references for the governed task are present; missing mandatory authority or validation references fail the criterion.

criteria.name: CONSISTENCY
criteria.rule: Requirement, plan, semantic, decision, activation-profile and task bindings do not contain contradictory values or incompatible authority lineage.

criteria.name: IMPLEMENTABILITY
criteria.rule: The approved task boundary has explicit implementation targets, dependencies, validation obligations and a governed execution path without relying on an undefined capability or semantic assumption.

criteria.name: DEPENDENCY_INTEGRITY
criteria.rule: Required prerequisites are explicit and satisfiable for MIGRATION_APPROVED_PLAN; the migration quality bootstrap does not create a dependency on TASK-ORCH-06.

criteria.name: TESTABILITY
criteria.rule: Required behavior and gate obligations map to stable test or deterministic evidence identifiers, and missing, skipped, timeout or unresolved verifier evidence cannot be promoted to PASS.

criteria.name: SECURITY_INTEGRITY
criteria.rule: Existing broker-only, exact authorization, authorization-not-security, secret-scan and no-raw-sensitive-result-persistence obligations are preserved; no security relaxation is introduced.

criteria.name: SEMANTIC_INTEGRITY
criteria.rule: Requirement, plan, semantic contract and execution-authority meanings remain aligned; no new product requirement, product scope, permission or completion truth is invented by migration quality projection.

criteria.name: TRACEABILITY
criteria.rule: Each applicable requirement has an exact path through plan task, semantic authority and validation/test evidence, with unresolved blocking issues retained as blocking.

activation_conditions: bounded authority-recovery report records legacy policy/final quality source as not found in verified sources
